title: Air India's $2.3 Billion Problem, a Wild Night of Emergency Landings, and the Vending Machine That Sold Death Insurance
summary: Air India loses billions and brings in the guy who fixed Ethiopian Airlines — can he do it twice? Plus, three different planes had very bad days in the last 24 hours, Virgin Atlantic finally launches its Phuket route, American wants flight attendants selling credit cards or else, and the weirdest piece of aviation history you'll hear this week: airport vending machines that sold flight insurance.
